stem: Which one of the following term characterizes the interaction between herpes simplex virus and a human?
expl: A parasite requires the host cell’s metabolic energy and the host’s protein-synthesis system for replication, and this causes harm to the host cell. Therefore, such a biological relationship is called parasitism. The Herpes simplex virus lives inside human cells and is completely dependent on them for nutrition and replication, and it harms humans; hence, the “interaction” (biological relationship) between the two is correctly termed parasitism, which is expressed by option (a). Endoparasitism is also essentially a subtype of parasitism in which the parasite lives inside the host’s body. This is also applicable in the context of the interaction between Herpes simplex virus and humans. Possibly considering this as correct, the Bihar Public Service Commission gave its answer as option (d).

stem: Every year 5 lakhs of indians die of a disease. identify it-
expl: Tuberculosis (Yakshma/Tapedik/Kshaya Rog) is an infectious disease caused by a bacterium named Mycobacterium tuberculosis. In this disease, the human lungs are affected. Symptoms include fever, continuous cough, blood in the sputum, shortness of breath, etc. According to the Global TB Report 2025 released by the World Health Organization in November 2025, India has recorded a 21% reduction in the annually reported new TB cases. In 2015, the number of TB-affected persons per lakh population in India was 237, which decreased to 187 in 2024. This is almost double the global rate of decline (12%).

stem: Female Anopheles can be distinguished from female Culex because it sits

options.label: a
options.text: At right angle to the surface of the substratum

options.label: b
options.text: At an angle with the substratum

options.label: c
options.text: Parallel to the surface of the substratum

options.label: d
options.text: More than one of the above

expl: Female Anopheles can be distinguished from female Culex because it rests at an angle to the substratum. Globally, more than 3,500 species of mosquitoes are found, and they are divided into three genera—Culex, Anopheles, and Aedes. Each genus works as an intermediate host for a specific parasite. Besides this, there are sufficient differences among them in terms of food chain, shape, habitat, etc. Difference between Culex and Anopheles– Culex Their eggs are laid in clusters on the surface of water. Their larvae feed from below. Their wings are transparent. They are capable of flying long distances. Their body remains parallel to the substratum. Anopheles Eggs are laid separately (not in clusters) on the water surface. They lay eggs in a horizontal pattern. Their larvae feed from above. Their wings are spotted. They cannot fly long distances. Their body rests at an angle to the substratum.

Which of the following pairs are correctly matched?
1. Anorexia : Sleep disorder
2. insomnia : Eating disorder
3. Dyspnoea : Shortness of breath
4. Anosmia : Partial or full loss of smell
Select the correct answer using the codes given below.
expl: Anorexia — Anorexia nervosa is an eating-related disorder. A person suffering from it remains anxious/apprehensive about body weight, due to which they avoid eating food. insomnia — Insomnia is a sleep disorder. A person suffering from it faces problems such as difficulty in falling asleep, walking up too early or having disturbed sleep and not getting good-quality sleep etc. Dyspnea — Dyspnea (dyspnoea) is a disorder related to breathing problems. Anosmia — It is a disorder related to the sense of smell. A person suffering from it has difficulty in smelling. Since pairs 3 and 4 are correctly matched, the required answer option (a) is correct.
